name: Meg Peterson
reason: Too thin: meg-peterson.com (Wix) lists every service on one price-list page (/blank) whose workshop 'details' links are missing or under construction, so there are no separate URLs for her Quantum-Touch Level 1-4 workshops; at most two items (sessions and readings via the price list and a TidyCal booking page) could be listed. Her site's photos are on static.wixstatic.com, which refuses our robots.txt. Much of the price list is spa and bodywork (Green Peel facials, detox foot machine, reflexology, lymph care), which the health rule leaves out.
